name: unsafe fn reborrow (& mut self) -> & 'a mut T
rule: Before calling `DormantMutRef::reborrow`, the prior reborrow must have ended: the reference returned by `DormantMutRef::new` and all pointers and references derived from it must not be used anymore.
api: impl < 'a , T > alloc::collections::btree::borrow::DormantMutRef < 'a , T > { unsafe fn reborrow (& mut self) -> & 'a mut T }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it has no observation for whether the prior reborrow has ended or whether derived pointers and references will be used again.
